title: Invesco Mortgage Capital Inc. Reports First Quarter 2026 Financial Results
summary: Invesco Mortgage Capital Inc. (NYSE: IVR) (the "Company") today announced financial results for the quarter ended March 31, 2026. Net loss per common share of $0.28 compared to net income of $0.68 in Q4 2025 Earnings available for distribution per common share (1) of $0.55 compared to $0.56 in Q4 2025 Monthly common stock dividends totaling $0.36 per share compared to quarterly dividend of $0.36 in Q4 2025 Book value per common share (2) of $8.08 compared to $8.72 as of December 31, 2025 Economic return (3) of (3.2)% compared to 8.0% in Q4 2025 Debt-to-equity ratio of 6.1x compared to 7.0x as of December 31, 2025 Economic debt-to-equity ratio (1) of 7.5x compared to 7.0x as of December 31, 2025 Update from Kevin Collins, Incoming Chief Executive Officer "During the first quarter of 2026, we operated in a more challenging market environment following the strong recovery in Agency MBS valuations experienced in the second half of 2025.
